tools.name: compute_tax
tools.description: Deterministic Indian income tax computation for a fiscal year. Handles new/old regime slabs, standard deduction, 87A rebate with marginal relief, 111A/112A capital gains rates, surcharge (with the 15% cap on gains), and 4% cess. All arithmetic is done in code from a versioned rule pack -- never estimated.

regime.description: Tax regime. 'new' (115BAC) is the default regime since FY 2023-24.

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary income in INR, before standard deduction

otherIncome.description: Other normal-rate income in INR (interest, net rent, etc.)

stcg111A.description: Short-term capital gains under section 111A (listed equity, STT paid) in INR

ltcg112A.description: Long-term capital gains under section 112A in INR, BEFORE the 1.25L exemption

deductions.description: Old regime only: total Chapter VI-A deductions (80C, 80D, ...) in INR. Ignored under the new regime.

ageBand.description: Age band: below60, senior (60-79), superSenior (80+). Affects old-regime exemption only.

tools.name: compare_regimes
tools.description: Compute tax under BOTH regimes for the same income and return a side-by-side comparison with the recommended regime and the savings amount. Pass the old-regime deductions you could actually claim; the new regime ignores them.

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary income in INR, before standard deduction

otherIncome.description: Other normal-rate income in INR (interest, net rent, etc.)

stcg111A.description: Short-term capital gains under section 111A (listed equity, STT paid) in INR

ltcg112A.description: Long-term capital gains under section 112A in INR, BEFORE the 1.25L exemption

deductions.description: Old regime only: total Chapter VI-A deductions (80C, 80D, ...) in INR. Ignored under the new regime.

ageBand.description: Age band: below60, senior (60-79), superSenior (80+). Affects old-regime exemption only.

tools.name: schedule_advance_tax
tools.description: Build the advance tax installment plan (Jun 15 / Sep 15 / Dec 15 / Mar 15 at 15/45/75/100%) for an estimated tax liability net of TDS. Reports per-installment amounts and shortfalls against what has been paid so far.

estimatedTax.description: Estimated total tax liability for the FY in INR (use compute_tax first)

tdsExpected.description: TDS/TCS expected to be deducted during the year in INR

paidSoFar.description: Advance tax already paid per installment, in order

tools.name: list_deductions
tools.description: Return the old-regime deduction checklist with statutory caps for a fiscal year (80C, 80CCD(1B), 80D tiers, 80TTA/TTB, 24(b), HRA metro list). Useful for estimating the `deductions` input to compute_tax/compare_regimes.

tools.name: parse_form26as
tools.description: Parse the caret-delimited Form 26AS TEXT export from TRACES into structured TDS entries (deductor, TAN, section, amounts) with totals. Download the 'Text' format from TRACES -- it needs no password. PDF exports are not supported; the text export is more reliable.

path.description: Absolute path to the 26AS .txt file downloaded from TRACES

tools.name: parse_ais
tools.description: Decrypt and parse the AIS JSON export from the income tax portal, entirely on-device. Provide pan + dob (DDMMYYYY) to derive the password, or pass it explicitly. Returns taxpayer info and normalized information rows (TDS entries, SFT transactions) with amounts, dates, and codes extracted by column label. The decryption scheme is reverse-engineered from the AIS utility; if it fails, use the portal's CSV export as a fallback and file an issue.

path.description: Absolute path to the downloaded AIS .json file

pan.description: PAN (used to derive the decryption password)

dob.description: Date of birth as DDMMYYYY (or DD-MM-YYYY); date of incorporation for non-individuals

tools.name: compute_interest_234
tools.description: Deterministic sections 234B and 234C interest on advance-tax shortfalls. 234B: 1%/month on assessed-minus-advance when advance < 90% (from 1 April of the AY). 234C: per-installment shortfalls with the statutory 12%/36% safe harbors for June/September. Rule 119A rounding applied (principal floored to Rs 100, part month = full month).

assessedTax.description: Tax on total income minus TDS/TCS and reliefs, in INR

advanceTaxPaid.description: Total advance tax paid during the FY

monthsFor234B.description: Months from 1 April of the AY to payment/assessment (part month = full month)

cumulativePaid.description: Cumulative advance tax paid by Jun 15 / Sep 15 / Dec 15 / Mar 15, for 234C

tools.name: compute_hra
tools.description: HRA exemption per Rule 2A: least of (actual HRA, rent minus 10% of salary, 50% metro / 40% non-metro of salary), computed period-wise. Salary = basic + retirement-forming DA + fixed-percentage turnover commission. Old regime only; metro list for FY 2025-26 is Delhi/Mumbai/Kolkata/Chennai. Also computes the 80GG alternative for rent payers with no HRA.

periods.description: Homogeneous periods (amounts are per-period totals, not monthly)

eightyGG.description: Compute 80GG instead (requires: no HRA received at any time in the year)

tools.name: reconcile_documents
tools.description: Cross-document mismatch report -- the checks that pre-empt 143(1)(a) intimations and 139(9) defect notices: TDS claimed vs 26AS deposited (the ledger of record), missing-employer detection, AIS interest/dividend vs declared, Form 16 vs 26AS per-TAN totals. Pass whichever documents you have; checks needing missing inputs are reported as skipped.

tools.name: recommend_itr_form
tools.description: Recommend ITR-1/2/3/4 for an individual from income heads, residency, losses, and disqualifier flags, with rule-by-rule reasoning. Loss-continuity aware: brought-forward business/speculative losses force ITR-3 even with zero current-year business income (Schedule CFL). Returns the filing deadline and 234F late fee for the recommended form.

residency.description: Residential status for the FY (RNOR/NRI cannot file ITR-1/ITR-4)

totalIncome.description: Estimated gross total income in INR before Chapter VI-A deductions

houseProperties.description: Number of house properties with income or loss

stcg111A.description: STCG under 111A in INR (any amount rules out ITR-1/ITR-4)

ltcg112A.description: LTCG under 112A in INR before the 1.25L exemption

hasOtherCapitalGains.description: Capital gains outside 111A/112A: property, debt MF, unlisted or foreign shares

hasBusinessIncome.description: Any business or professional income this year, incl. F&O trading and freelancing

businessLoss.description: Non-speculative business loss (incl. F&O) brought forward or arising this year

speculativeLoss.description: Speculative (intraday equity) loss brought forward or arising this year

capitalLoss.description: Capital loss (STCL/LTCL) brought forward or to carry forward

housePropertyLoss.description: House property loss to carry forward

hasForeignAssetsOrIncome.description: Foreign assets/income incl. vested RSUs or ESPP of a foreign parent (Schedule FA)

isDirector.description: Director in any company during the FY

holdsUnlistedShares.description: Held unlisted equity shares during the FY

agriIncome.description: Agricultural income in INR (above 5,000 rules out ITR-1/ITR-4)

hasLotteryOrGamingIncome.description: Winnings from lottery, online games, or racehorses

tools.name: filing_checklist
tools.description: Ordered, form-specific walkthrough for filing ITR-1/2/3/4 on incometax.gov.in: documents to gather, reconciliation, tax computation, portal steps schedule by schedule, and e-verification. Guidance only -- the taxpayer performs the final submit on the portal themselves.

form.description: The ITR form to file (use recommend_itr_form if unsure)

tools.name: list_tax_years
tools.description: List the fiscal years this server has rule packs for, with filing deadlines for the current assessment year.
